privatePatients.address: B-304, Shreemad Residency, Gotri Road, Vadodara, Gujarat
privatePatients.chiefComplaints: Severe right shoulder pain, inability to sleep on right side, and restricted overhead reach (> 6 weeks).
privatePatients.clinicalDiagnosis: Adhesive Capsulitis (Frozen Shoulder - Freezing to Frozen Stage)
privatePatients.medicalHistory: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus (HbA1c 7.6%) on Metformin 500mg BD. No history of shoulder dislocation.

physiotherapyAssessment.romFindings: Active Abduction: 75° (painful arc 60°-75°); External Rotation at side: 15° (contralateral 65°); Passive Flexion: 95° firm capsular end-feel.
physiotherapyAssessment.mmtFindings: Supraspinatus: Grade 4/5 (inhibited by pain); Subscapularis: 4+/5; Infraspinatus: 3+/5.
physiotherapyAssessment.postureGaitFindings: Slight anterior head carriage, right shoulder elevation, rounded shoulder posture.
physiotherapyAssessment.specialTestsFindings: Hawkins-Kennedy: Positive; Neer Test: Positive; Empty Can Test: Painful without drop arm; Speed Test: Negative.
physiotherapyAssessment.functionalFindings: QuickDASH: 58.2/100; SPADI: 64/100. Unable to reach back pocket or fasten seatbelt.
physiotherapyAssessment.clinicalImpression: Classic diabetic stiff shoulder with severe capsular contracture and capsuloligamentous hypomobility.

treatmentPlan.shortTermGoals: Reduce night pain NPRS from 7 to <= 3 within 3 weeks; achieve 35° active external rotation and 120° passive flexion.
treatmentPlan.longTermGoals: Achieve functional overhead reach (150°+ elevation) and return to full independence in personal grooming.
treatmentPlan.prescribedExercises: Maitland Grade II-III inferior and posterior glenohumeral mobilizations, pendulum swings, table slides, wand active-assisted elevation, doorway submaximal pectoral stretching.
treatmentPlan.dosageSetsReps: Pendulum 3x30 sec, table slides 3x10 reps twice daily; wand exercises 3x10 reps.
treatmentPlan.frequencyAndDuration: 3 supervised clinical sessions/week for 8 weeks + daily home exercise protocol.
treatmentPlan.precautions: Do not force aggressive high-velocity passive manipulation beyond patient tolerance; monitor diabetic blood sugar.
treatmentPlan.progressionCriteria: Progress to rotator cuff isometric strengthening once external rotation passes 40° and resting pain <= 3/10.

treatmentSessions.treatmentGiven: Gentle Maitland Grade II inferior glide mobilizations, moist heat application 10 min, pendulum exercise guidance.
treatmentSessions.patientResponse: Reported immediate relaxation in anterior joint line; pain eased during pendulum movement.
treatmentSessions.therapistNotes: Educated patient on diabetic predisposition to prolonged adhesive capsulitis.

treatmentSessions.treatmentGiven: Grade II-III posterior capsular glide, seated wand active-assisted flexion, cross-body adduction stretch.
treatmentSessions.therapistNotes: Patient compliant with twice-daily home wand exercises.

treatmentSessions.treatmentGiven: Grade III inferior and posterior glides, theraband yellow internal/external rotation isometrics at 0° abduction.
treatmentSessions.patientResponse: Able to sleep 5 hours continuously without waking up from shoulder throb.
treatmentSessions.therapistNotes: Night pain dropped from 7 to 4 on NPRS.

documents.title: Right Shoulder MRI Plain & Contrast Report
documents.notes: Axioradiology Vadodara: Confirmed thickening of coracohumeral ligament and axillary recess capsule (4.2 mm). Intact rotator cuff tendons.

documents.notes: Baseline ROM goniometric charting and SPADI score documentation.

privatePatients.address: 42, Alkapuri Society, Near Railway Station, Vadodara, Gujarat
privatePatients.chiefComplaints: Bilateral knee pain during morning rising, cracking crepitus, and severe difficulty squatting or taking temple stairs.
privatePatients.clinicalDiagnosis: Bilateral Primary Knee Osteoarthritis (Kellgren-Lawrence Grade III Medial Compartment)
privatePatients.medicalHistory: Hypertension controlled on Telmisartan 40mg. Mild lumbar spondylosis.

physiotherapyAssessment.romFindings: Right Knee: Flexion 105° (firm end-feel), Extension -5° lag; Left Knee: Flexion 110°, Extension 0°.
physiotherapyAssessment.mmtFindings: Quadriceps (VMO): Grade 3+/5 bilateral; Hip Abductors (Gluteus Medius): 3+/5; Hamstrings: 4/5.
physiotherapyAssessment.postureGaitFindings: Mild bilateral genu varum (bowed knees), reduced stance time on right limb, slow walking cadence (88 steps/min).
physiotherapyAssessment.specialTestsFindings: Patellar Grind (Clarke) Test: Positive bilateral; McMurray Test: Negative; Medial Joint Line Tenderness: Positive grade 2.
physiotherapyAssessment.functionalFindings: WOMAC Index: 54/96; 30-Second Chair Stand: 7 repetitions with handrest push-off; Timed Up and Go (TUG): 14.8 seconds.
physiotherapyAssessment.clinicalImpression: Advanced medial tibiofemoral joint space narrowing with secondary quadriceps arthrogenic inhibition and extensor lag.

treatmentPlan.shortTermGoals: Achieve 0° right knee full extension and reduce stair climbing pain NPRS to <= 3 within 4 weeks.
treatmentPlan.longTermGoals: Achieve >= 12 repetitions on 30s chair stand without arm assistance; independent community walking > 2 km.
treatmentPlan.prescribedExercises: High-intensity NMES quad sets, seated heel slides with towel assistance, mini closed-chain squats (0°-45°), supine straight leg raises with 1kg cuff weight, non-impact recumbent stationary cycling.
treatmentPlan.dosageSetsReps: Quad sets 3x10 (10s hold), SLR 3x10, mini-squats 3x10 twice daily.
treatmentPlan.frequencyAndDuration: 3 clinic sessions/week for 6 weeks + daily home compliance.
treatmentPlan.precautions: Strictly avoid deep squats > 60° and cross-legged sitting (Sukhasana) during acute flare-up.
treatmentPlan.progressionCriteria: Progress to backward treadmill walking and lateral step-ups when 30s chair stand >= 10 reps.

treatmentSessions.treatmentGiven: Medial and superior patellar mobilization Grade II-III, isometric quad sets with biofeedback, cryotherapy 15 min.
treatmentSessions.patientResponse: Felt lighter in knees when getting off treatment couch.
treatmentSessions.therapistNotes: Educated patient on weight management and avoidance of low stool sitting.

treatmentSessions.treatmentGiven: NMES 15 min on VMO, straight leg raises, stationary cycling 10 min low resistance.
treatmentSessions.patientResponse: Able to complete 8 reps of chair stand.
treatmentSessions.therapistNotes: Quadriceps activation noticeably crisper on palpation.

documents.title: Bilateral Weight-Bearing Knee Radiographs (AP & Lateral)
documents.notes: Significant medial joint space loss, subchondral sclerosis, and marginal osteophytes. Lateral compartment intact.

privatePatients.address: Flat 12, Nilamber Greens, Vasna-Bhayli Main Road, Vadodara
privatePatients.chiefComplaints: Acute right lower back pain with sharp shooting electric shock down postero-lateral calf to right big toe.
privatePatients.clinicalDiagnosis: L4-L5 Lumbar Disc Herniation with Right L5 Radiculopathy
privatePatients.medicalHistory: Software engineer with 9-10 hours sedentary desk work daily. No previous spinal surgeries.

physiotherapyAssessment.romFindings: Lumbar Flexion: Limited to 25° with immediate peripheralization into right calf; Lumbar Extension: 12° with centralizing back sensation.
physiotherapyAssessment.mmtFindings: Extensor Hallucis Longus (L5): Grade 4-/5; Tibialis Anterior (L4): 5/5; Peroneus Longus (S1): 5/5.
physiotherapyAssessment.postureGaitFindings: Antalgic lateral shift (scoliotic list to the left side away from the pain side); antalgic gait with shortened right stance.
physiotherapyAssessment.specialTestsFindings: Straight Leg Raise (SLR) Right: Positive at 35° (reproduces shooting leg pain); Crossed SLR (Well-leg raise): Positive at 50°; Slump Test: Positive; Babinski / Clonus: Negative.
physiotherapyAssessment.functionalFindings: Oswestry Disability Index (ODI): 52/100 (Severe disability); NPRS Leg Pain: 8/10; Back Pain: 4/10.
physiotherapyAssessment.clinicalImpression: Mechanical nerve root compression at L5 with acute neurodynamic sensitivity. Meets criteria for directional preference extension protocol.

treatmentPlan.shortTermGoals: Centralize shooting leg pain into the midline back within 10 days; eliminate lateral shift deformity.
treatmentPlan.longTermGoals: Achieve ODI <= 12/100; pain-free return to 8-hour ergonomic workstation work and gym workouts.
treatmentPlan.prescribedExercises: McKenzie directional preference prone press-ups (10 reps every 2 hours), manual correction of lateral shift, gentle sciatic neurodynamic sliding, McGill Big 3 core stabilization.
treatmentPlan.dosageSetsReps: Prone press-ups 10 reps every 2 waking hours; modified curl-up, side bridge, bird-dog 3x10s holds.
treatmentPlan.frequencyAndDuration: Daily home directional preference + 2 supervised clinic sessions/week.
treatmentPlan.precautions: Strictly avoid sustained lumbar flexion, lifting from floor, and sit-ups; screen for Cauda Equina red flags.
treatmentPlan.progressionCriteria: Progress to loaded hip hinge and deadlifts once leg pain remains completely absent for 3 consecutive weeks.

treatmentSessions.treatmentGiven: Manual correction of left lateral shift against wall, passive prone lying on pillows 5 min, repeated prone extensions in lying.
treatmentSessions.patientResponse: Electric shock sensation retreated from foot up into upper buttock (centralization confirmed).
treatmentSessions.therapistNotes: Educated patient on McKenzie centralization phenomenon and lumbar roll support for chair.

treatmentSessions.treatmentGiven: Prone press-ups with therapist overpressure, sciatic nerve flossing in supine, McGill side bridge.
treatmentSessions.patientResponse: Leg pain completely centralized into right sacral area; no calf pain when standing.
treatmentSessions.therapistNotes: SLR improved from 35° to 65° without pain recurrence.

treatmentSessions.treatmentGiven: Advanced core bracing, standing hip hinge retraining with dowel, ergonomic workstation setup review.
treatmentSessions.patientResponse: NPRS 1/10. Able to sit for 45 minutes with lumbar roll without leg symptoms.
treatmentSessions.therapistNotes: EHL strength normalized to Grade 5/5. ODI reduced to 16/100.

documents.notes: Synergy Imaging Vadodara: L4-L5 right paracentral disc protrusion compressing descending right L5 nerve root.

documents.notes: Discharge ODI 8/100, full straight leg raise 80° bilateral pain-free. Cleared for normal recreational gym activity.
